---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for ORQEN
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem this feature would solve. What use case does it address?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you'd like to see implemented. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered. Why is your proposed solution better?

## Use Cases

List specific scenarios where this feature would be useful:

1. Use case 1
2. Use case 2
3. Use case 3

## Implementation Ideas (Optional)

If you have ideas on how this could be implemented, share them here. This could include:

- Which packages/components would be affected
- API changes
- Configuration options
- Breaking changes and migration path

## Additional Context

Any other information, mockups, references, or links that might be helpful.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and discussions for similar requests
- [ ] This feature aligns with ORQEN's architecture and design principles
- [ ] I am willing to contribute to the implementation (optional)
